title: Example Salted Brown Butter Cupcake
description: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY - not a tested recipe. Shows sections, allergens and tips.
allergenNote: soy lecithin in the white chocolate

ingredients.name: White chocolate
ingredients.note: Label: sugar, cocoa butter, milk, soy lecithin, vanilla. May contain tree nuts.

steps: Brown the butter over medium heat until nutty; cool 20 minutes.
Whisk the browned butter with the sugar, then the eggs one at a time.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt; add to the batter alternately with the milk.
Beat the salted butter until pale, then the powdered sugar and vanilla.
Pipe the frosting, then finish with white chocolate and flaky salt.

tips.title: Why cool the butter
tips.text: Hot browned butter melts the sugar and thins the batter, which makes domed, coarse crumbs.

tips.title: Cottage food check
tips.text: American buttercream (butter + powdered sugar, no eggs) is the safest frosting for cottage food. Your health department may still ask for a water activity test.

storage: Room temperature in a closed box. Shelf life to be confirmed by testing.
notes: Example only. Not a tested formula.
